policy.ids: Include valid positive numeric IDs only. Blank-ID draft rows remain pending.
policy.source: Use live Sheets for confirmed gameplay fields. Preserve stable IDs and wiki schema.
exceptions: Chest ID 77 uses HeartwoodCache by explicit project decision; live Chest Sheet still says DryadPineGroveCache.
policy.scope: Wiki covers gameplay data, quest objectives, requirements, stages, rewards, and mechanics; dialogue transcripts are excluded. Source event dialogue fields may remain in underlying stage JSON but are not displayed or localized as a wiki feature.
policy.versioning: Wiki version is independent of game's Ver Log; never claim full game-version parity without completed audit.
include: Main Quest objectives, requirements and rewards
Named, gameplay-relevant Special Events and Missions
Gameplay mechanics, stages, locations and references
exclude: NPC and player dialogue transcripts and option scripts
Raw internal event rows with no standalone gameplay purpose
policy.specialEventClassification: Zero associated quests does not mean universal; keep relevant named encounters. Universal event source rows are intentionally excluded and must not be counted as missing.

ongoingWorkstreams.mechanics: Ongoing documentation and changes; not necessarily a blocker for a verified data snapshot.
ongoingWorkstreams.delivery: Ongoing navigation, UI and publishing improvements; actual broken display remains an issue.

policy.publicDisplay: Present Wiki Version, Sheets Version and human-readable Updated / Ongoing / Excluded sections; no technical identifiers.
policy.incrementalSync: Wiki and Sheets versions are tracked independently.

entries.summary: Created immutable pre-sync reference branch at commit ede83aa.

Synchronized confirmed item prices, skill effects/cooldown, tile fields and one quest grade; added 31 ID-backed source records with related localization and manifests; preserved Chest ID 77 as HeartwoodCache.
entries.notes: Complete cross-reference, localization, event coverage and site verification remain outstanding.

entries.summary: Checked IDs and partitions for 291 monsters, 374 active skills, 134 passive skills, and 194 items; validated all six newly added TileArea grids as 12×12 and checked 824 represented event steps against live source fields.
entries.notes: Full cross-reference, all-localization, runtime/browser verification remain outstanding. Chest ID 77 HeartwoodCache is an explicit exception to the current live Chest Sheet.

entries.summary: Corrected the five new Monster localizations to existing flat-language schema and verified complete en/zh-CN/zh-TW name coverage for Monsters (291), Active Skills (374), Passive Skills (134), Items (194), and Tile Data (145). Confirmed linked new Monster skills and two item tile-unlock IDs, and HeartwoodCache chest references.
entries.notes: Complete descriptions, references outside new record families, and deployed browser smoke test still pending.

entries.summary: Verified complete EN, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese descriptions for all 194 Item and 125 Equipment localization records. Identified empty special-event-localisation.json in repository; special-event UI requests this file, so localized special-event text remains unverified and requires regeneration from the Localization Sheet.
entries.notes: GitHub Pages URLs could not be opened by the verification service. No synthesized translations or unsupported runtime claims.

entries.summary: Confirmed dialog transcripts are out of scope for Isekaimania Wiki. Special Events should show objectives, conditions, stages and rewards, not conversations.
entries.notes: Empty special-event-localisation.json remains a potential objective-text localization gap rather than a dialogue-translation obligation.

entries.summary: Restored 841 non-dialogue localized Quest/Event Group objective and title keys to special-event-localisation.json from the live Quests & Event Groups localization tab. Added two missing Baron Mabon quest title/description keys and updated a changed description.
entries.notes: 15 Special Events group/title/description references lack a matching key in this source and need classification. Dialogue transcripts remain excluded.

entries.summary: Formalized content inclusion/exclusion policy in WIKI_CONTENT_SCOPE.md. Exclude dialogue and universal/system Special Events from presentation, audit counts and localization requirements; preserve named gameplay events and quest objectives.
entries.notes: All current 51 Special Events wiki groups are named events; generic source-sheet handlers are not included as standalone wiki groups.

entries.summary: Resolved 3 gameplay objective template localization keys from live SpecialEvents source; localized Special Events objective dictionary now contains 844 keys.
entries.notes: 12 named zero-quest event groups lack exact localization entries in SpecialEvents and Quests & Event Groups tabs. They remain pending classification; not automatically universal. Dialogues remain excluded.

entries.summary: Retain all 12 named single-stage Special Events despite missing exact group-title localization and zero associated quests. No fabricated translations; exclude universal/system events and dialogues.

Reviewed quest condition/reward strings for 254 named Special Event and Mission groups (240 quest records). Confirmed DryadPineGroveIncident quest ID 266 explicitly references newly added Living Pineheart and retains its source reward data.
entries.notes: This is a targeted reference review, not exhaustive validation of all linked keys. Twelve user-approved named event groups remain included; universal events and dialogues remain excluded.

entries.summary: Validated ten explicit new-content gameplay links: 8 Skeleton boss skill/passive references, Verdara Helmet in Dryad Pine Grove equipment loot, and HeartwoodCache in its chest list. Checked new tile lock requirements for Living Pineheart (ID 141) and Military Access Seal (ID 144), whose item unlock targets were verified previously.
entries.notes: Full legacy-partition cross-reference scan not completed due to connector request limits; it must not be represented as fully verified.

entries.summary: Validated Monster IDs 1–100 loot entries against all 194 Items and 125 Equipment, correctly parsing numeric loot quantity suffixes. All references resolved. Checked all 125 Equipment crafting recipes: 259 references, including 227 Item and 32 Equipment materials; no unresolved recipe materials.
entries.notes: Broader Monster skill and Tile Data references, quests and deployed browser tests remain to be checked. No gameplay data changed.

entries.summary: Verified all 514 Monster passive and 702 active skill references across 291 Monsters: no missing skills. Checked all 145 Tile Data chest references against all 81 Chests; normalized two malformed chest lists on Tile IDs 59 and 139 directly from the live TileData source Sheet.
entries.notes: Tile 59 chest list now GemCache and PrismaticGemHoard. Tile 139 chest list now ThunderUtilityCrate2 and StormgridCoreCache. All chest keys in both corrected records resolve. Other Tile Data encounter/team/loot references and browser verification still pending.

entries.summary: Compared all 145 Tile Data enemy/special team and item/equipment loot lists against live TileData rows. Corrected lists on Tile IDs 15, 21, 28, 58, 59, 71; fixed Tile ID 12 team name typo to match canonical EnemyTeams ID 141.
entries.notes: Tile ID 12 key differs from the current TileData Sheet ('2 SquirrelDefender'), so the canonical EnemyTeams reference is a documented source exception. Mechanics and delivery remain ongoing workstreams, not permanent blockers.

entries.summary: Compared 240 quest records referenced by the named Special Events and Missions against the live Quest Sheet (324 numeric-ID source records). All 240 IDs were found and all 16 compared gameplay fields matched, including completion conditions/outcomes, map restrictions and unlock requirements.
entries.notes: This verifies the 240 included Special Event and Mission quest records, not every Quest source row; excluded universal event handlers and dialogue remain out of scope. Main Quest and complete source parity still need sign-off.

entries.summary: Compared all 15 Main Quest groups and 83 quests against the live Quest Sheet. Corrected Baron Mabon group from five to six source quests with IDs 319–324, current quest order, conditions, rewards and requirements; updated its manifest count. All 83 quests now match the source across compared gameplay fields.
entries.notes: Mechanics documentation and delivery improvements remain ongoing; this audit establishes Main Quest data parity only, not full-site game-version parity. Dialogue and universal Special Events remain excluded.

entries.summary: Compared the live gameplay Sheets' numeric ID sets against wiki records for Monsters (291), Active Skills (374), Passive Skills (134), Items (194), Equipment (125), Chests (81), Tile Data (145), Tile Areas (83 unique IDs), Characters (10), and Jobs (51). Category counts match. Exact ID-set comparison confirms Equipment, Chests, Tile Data, Tile Areas, Characters and Jobs; these key/name fields also match except the explicitly approved Chest 77 HeartwoodCache exception.
entries.notes: This is not a full field-by-field audit of every gameplay record. Some categories' ID sets were only count-checked here. Mechanics documentation and delivery remain ongoing, separately from source-data checkpoints.

maintenance.purpose: Incremental future wiki updates without unnecessary full database re-audits
updateProcedure: Read confirmed new game release and changed source records
Apply only documented in-scope additions and field changes by exact source identifiers
Check dependent references, relevant localized display text and publication
Add structured entry for each meaningful source change; preserve original audit history
Update public Updated/Ongoing/Excluded sections, observed Sheets version and only verified checkpoints
maintenance.displayPolicy: Internal source IDs, canonical keys, diff payloads and technical filenames remain in machine-readable records, not on public Version Log page.
